name: Turista (Tourist) Temporary Status

requirements.blocker_text: Entry must be for tourism, leisure, or health-related activities only; no lucrative work is permitted under this status.
Permitted stay is up to 183 days, cumulative within a rolling 365-day period; not extendable beyond that cap.

evidence_required.document: Visa (issued by RREE) unless the applicant's nationality is visa-exempt, in which case MIGRACIONES admits directly at the border

outcome.duration_length: up to 183 days, cumulative within a 365-day period

sources.title: Superintendencia Nacional de Migraciones (MIGRACIONES) -- Reglamento del Decreto Legislativo N.1350, Ley de Migraciones, Article 29.1.h: Turista temporary immigration status, up to 183 days cumulative within 365 days, not extendable, issued by RREE or directly by MIGRACIONES for visa-exempt nationalities

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Peru). Peru organizes all immigration statuses under a single legal instrument, the 'calidad migratoria' system created by Decreto Legislativo N.1350 (2017) and its regulation (Decreto Supremo N.007-2017-IN) -- this is the primary law backing most routes in this build, fetched directly from MIGRACIONES' own site. Turista is a TEMPORAL (non-resident) status, distinct from the RESIDENCIA categories used for settlement-track routes elsewhere in this build. No work of any kind is permitted under this status; a person wishing to work must switch to Trabajador or another qualifying category, not extend Turista.
